verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a developer-facing SaaS platform like Brevo, so the axis applies. The evidence documents official SDKs (Node.js, Python, PHP), a Postman workspace, an MCP integration, an n8n node and llms.txt, but no official command-line tool. These adjacent developer tools do not count as a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
